# has role

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasRole>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a membership to the role the member plays. Domain is [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) so the role is borne by the relator, not the agent — a person plays a role THROUGH a membership, never as a subclass of themselves ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). Non-functional: a membership may carry several roles.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) -> [`gmeow:Role`](../classes/gmeow-Role.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md) from [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) to [`gmeow:Role`](../classes/gmeow-Role.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:Role`](../classes/gmeow-Role.md) to a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) — the function the member plays within the organization for the duration of that membership.

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching it to the agent directly (the role rides the membership relator, not the person) and avoid using it for the holder-independent seat — that is [`gmeow:fillsPost`](gmeow-fillsPost.md) pointing at a [`gmeow:Post`](../classes/gmeow-Post.md).

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md) triples to a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md) referencing [`gmeow:Role`](../classes/gmeow-Role.md) individuals; pair with [`gmeow:fillsPost`](gmeow-fillsPost.md) when the role is a named, holder-independent seat.

### Examples

- ex:emp [`gmeow:hasRole`](gmeow-hasRole.md) ex:cfoRole.
